entries.title: Fixed Side Deck and Raised Roof Stage Trailer
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed expanded performance-stage trailer exterior. A tandem-wheel longitudinal chassis and converging tow yoke carry a raised main deck and continuous low rear backboard. An entire hinged side-deck wing is fixed horizontal, with three complete hinge barrels at its inner edge and two full-height outer support legs on finite ground shoes. Four main stabilizer feet and telescopic-looking square corner columns join the chassis to a raised whole shallow pitched roof body, with separate inner posts, transverse retainers and underside roof beams. A complete short side stair runs to the open stage floor. The low rear side panel and raised overhead roof remain separated by an open performance bay. Unlike the complete arched stock trailer, there is no enclosing stock vault, internal divided pen or rear loading ramp; unlike the field-kitchen trailer, there are no cooking wells or furnace. The outboard horizontal floor wing with its own legs and the lifted corner-supported canopy form an integrated newly authored spatial apparatus, not a copied vehicle carrying old stage objects. Four opaque PBR materials, metres Z up, whole horizontal bounds centred. One static complete model zero scenes. No roof raising sequence, hinge or telescopic travel, towing/road compatibility, wheel motion, weather enclosure, usable clearance, load, occupancy, performance installation or safety ability made or verified. No people, audience, sound equipment, lighting system, rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Rosette Spindle and Low Pivot Rocking Lathe
entries.description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed ornamental-turning-inspired tabletop apparatus. A full low bed and four finite feet carry two fixed lower bearing pedestals supporting one complete elevated rocking head frame on a long low hinge. The upper horizontal spindle is parallel to that lower pivot rather than crossing it: two complete tall head cheeks and bored bearing collars join both levels. A true thick eight-lobed rosette plate is rooted on the rear spindle and visibly meets a separate fixed side stop stem carried on its own pedestal. The front spindle ends in one whole blank circular faceplate. An independent front transverse slide, raised toolpost and short blunt tool appearance remain visibly separated from the faceplate. A complete rear crank with offset grip and front slide handwheel finish the apparatus. No old lathe or dividing-head geometry imported. Unlike the fixed-head long-bed lathe there are no tailstock, longitudinal saddle, stepped chuck jaws or long feed rod. Unlike the tilting index head, the lower pivot runs parallel to the spindle and the rosette-to-side-stop relation belongs to the whole rocking head, not a perforated indexing disk on a transverse tilt axis. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, full horizontal bounds centred, one model zero scenes. entries.title: Whole Two Building And Rising Step Lane
entries.description: One complete static mountain-step-lane settlement scene, one scene and zero new standalone models. Only whole translations are applied. A new continuous finite sloping earth body, two connected terrace/approach pads and one whole nine-tread stone flight organize a low foreground approach, an uphill central lane and an upper turning landing in front of the storehouse. The lower cottage retains its original porch and fixed door, while the upper building retains its complete front loading opening and rear loft. Unlike the old four-cottage level straight residential street, building bases occupy two different supported elevations and the route rises between their nonoverlapping whole envelopes. Unlike the flat baffled ruin path, no retained breached wall forces the dogleg; the turn is a terrace connection after a real height change. This is not resized architecture or a same-plane rearrangement. Four newly authored meshes are scene-only landscape and route support, not additional assets. No old component removed, recoloured, reshaped or individually counted. Metres Z up, finite ground underside and centred scene envelope.
